title: Binance Will Update the Collateral Ratio of Multiple Assets Under Portfolio Margin (2025-04-18)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will update the  collateral ratio  for the following assets under Portfolio Margin from  2025-04-18 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within approximately  one hour . Assets Collateral Ratio (Before) Collateral Ratio (After) DENT 65% 55% ENJ 70% 55% NOT 75% 60% DASH 70% 55% CHZ 80% 65% AXS 80% 70% ENS 80% 70% SAND 80% 70% THETA 80% 70% QNT 80% 70% Please Note:  Collateral ratio  will affect  the Unified Maintenance Margin Ratio (uniMMR). Users should monitor uniMMR closely to avoid any potential liquidation or losses that may result from the change of collateral ratio.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
